<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rout:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty plummeted over 1,000 points, erasing nearly ₹6 lakh crore in market capitalization as financial stocks faced intense selling pressure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Exchange volatility:</strong> NSE shares fell below their IPO issue price of ₹1,785, while BSE shares declined amid reports that SEBI is considering a high-level panel to revisit self-listing regulations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPYU53RC1ROTc5dEl2SnRPUXU5SURhWDB0WTVIY2Fnak5xT0VJY2xKSUs3bVB4blJYV0RoMVBDa253czNKNl9VS1lxWEVpMC1pOE96R0pzenRTZmpLRGRNOWV0UU1LeklYVkJsMTFCSmZXcExwcHFkOEh3V3NwQ1JGM21BdjJsYWtTY0ZLMnpLS2R6TXlpUGdpTFVR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary policy outlook:</strong> Analysts expect the RBI to continue its rate hike cycle, with projections for the terminal repo rate reaching 5.75% by December to combat persistent inflation and support growth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic headwinds:</strong> Indian markets are under significant pressure as global crude oil prices breach $100 per barrel, coupled with rising US bond yields and geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQRkNYRzVKeUlGMWZhV3h5Ukx3aVF1RlVxQjhZNGozWDg5dHZkOVFnOHY4ampkdTNrNThoMmVoSFBqS1Z2ZzZkNWZ3V1ZTLWxQeExQSWU5cXJXUHZSQTZ4bHl4d2lKM3lUczdHQXBBaU10dEE3SnVUc0ZaOERwVGZLVlphMzlnRUlVWTR0dkJ4bUtQanhZR0Q3OUJtc0s?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W23</a></span></li>
